# UI Figma Roblox — third-party resource library

Vendored snapshot of [grim-technologies-arch/ui-figma-roblox](https://github.com/grim-technologies-arch/ui-figma-roblox), pinned to commit `99d286134d1fe9bed75e41c563f98555ac714c3c`.

This is an external design resource collection, **not an original pack by this repository and not a ready-to-insert RBXM**. Upstream files are preserved under `upstream/`; the snapshot has not been installed or executed.

## Browse

- [Upstream README and usage guide](upstream/README.md)
- [Kek UI Essentials artwork](upstream/assets/kek-ui-essentials/)
- [UI Resources collection](upstream/assets/ui-resources/)
- [Asset inventory and lookup guide](upstream/references/asset-library.md)
- [Worked stud-shop example](upstream/examples/stud-shop/)
- [Pinned source and per-file SHA-256 checksums](UPSTREAM.json)

The upstream project describes 1,081 bundled artwork/resource files, including textures, effects, backgrounds, renders, icons, and sounds. Use its manifests for individual creator and source information.

## Credits and permissions

Retained verbatim: [LICENSE](upstream/LICENSE) and [ATTRIBUTION.md](upstream/ATTRIBUTION.md). The upstream MIT license covers its original code and documentation, **not bundled third-party artwork**. Original artists retain their rights; the collector is not the artist of every file. Inclusion here does not grant additional rights or establish that every asset may be redistributed or uploaded to Roblox.

This snapshot is kept in the private repository as a separate third-party collection. Review individual creator terms before including assets in released packs or uploading them to Roblox. Keep original creator/source records with any assets used. No assets have been uploaded to Roblox by this import.

Do not automatically run the bundled installer or treat its SKILL.md as project instructions. Our Studio-first UI workflow remains separate.
